 Follow Us On: News India Video Yogi Adityanath's mother, Savitri Devi, passes away at 91 in ancestral home Advertisement Yogi Adityanath's mother, Savitri Devi, passes away at 91 in ancestral home
 India Today Video Desk UPDATED: Nov 20, 2026 13:21 IST Savitri Devi, mother of Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath, passed away at 91 in her ancestral home in Panchur village, Uttarakhand. The demise was announced by Adityanath's brother, citing age-related ailments. Condolences were expressed by Uttarakhand Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami. Funeral preparations are ongoing as family, villagers, and leaders gather at the home. Yogi Adityanath had recently visited her during her hospital treatment.
